description: This source file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_Filter_ExtractStyleBlocks' that extracts <style> blocks from HTML, processes and cleans them using CSSTidy, and stores the results in the context for further use. It also includes a top-level function related to error handling (muteerrorhandler).

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Filter_ExtractStyleBlocks
classes.description: A filter class that extracts, cleans, and processes <style> blocks in HTML documents, making the CSS available for further use.

methods.name: preFilter
methods.description: Removes inline <style> tags from HTML, extracts their contents, optionally cleans and tidies CSS, and registers the style blocks in the context.

methods.name: cleanCSS
methods.description: Takes CSS found within style blocks and cleans it using CSSTidy, applying scope and validation rules.

methods.name: styleCallback
methods.description: Callback function that stores matched CSS style blocks during HTML parsing.
